GG! You won the match.

Final state:
- You (GPT-5-nano): 20 HP
- GPT-5: 0 HP
- Potions: You 0, GPT-5 0
- Last actions: You ATTACK; GPT-5 ATTACK

Would you like to start a new game? If so, I can reset to the starting conditions (100 HP, 2 potions each) and we can go again.

Good game! GPT-5-nano wins with 20 HP remaining.

Quick post-match notes:
- Your aggression was solid early, but once you dropped to 40 with two potions left, pre-healing to 70 on one of those turns could have avoided the later forced heal at 20 and preserved tempo.
- In fixed-damage duels, key thresholds matter: 40 HP risks getting locked into heal-or-die lines; 50–70 HP often lets you take a hit and keep attacking.
- For partial info, your opponent-tracking was reasonable; the endgame came down to being one attack short after they double-potioned.
